scheme_name: Assistance to Lawyers for Starting their Practice
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be an unemployed lawyer.
The beneficiary must have registered as a lawyer within the last 5 years.
The beneficiary must have an interest to start a legal practice.
Eligibility category noted in source: Adi Dravidar
Eligibility category noted in source: Tribal
benefits_summary: Financial assistance to help unemployed Adi Dravidar/Tribal lawyers start their legal practice.
documents_required: copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
